payload.description_html:
Partial skeleton of an Edmontosaurus annectens (herbivorous dinosaur, Hadrosauridae).

View of the thorax and pelvis.

Discovery place : county of Niobrara, State of Wyoming, in the United States.

Date of discovery : 1910. The skeleton was brought back to the National Museum of Natural History in Paris (France) in 1911. The majority of the skeleton had been prepared mecanichally, but it had never been reasembled and stayed in the reserves until 2018.

Datation : this animal lived during the Superior Cretaceous, during the Maastrichtian, 67 millions of years ago.

It was exhibited during the exhibition "Un T-rex à Paris" (" T-rex in Paris") in the National Museum of Natural History (Paris, France), from 6 June to 2 September 2018.
